How much does an NDT technician make?

In the United States an NDT technician typically earns $45,000–$70,000 a year at Level II, rising to $70,000–

20,000+ at Level III, with entry-level Level I roles starting around $35,000–$50,000. Method mix, industry and travel move the number substantially — aerospace, rope access and turnaround work pay above the base ranges.

NDT Salary Guide 2026: Global Pay by Certification Level, Method & Country

How much does an NDT technician earn in 2026? The median NDT Level II technician salary in the USA runs $55,000–$80,000, well above general quality-control roles (~$44,000), while advanced-method specialists (PAUT, TOFD, AUT) earn 40–80% premiums reaching $85,000–$115,000 at Level II and $130,000–$180,000 at Level III. Offshore work adds a further 30–50% premium. This guide covers real 2026 NDT salary data by ASNT certification level, method specialization, industry, and country — based on the ASNT 2025 Salary Survey and 50+ industry sources.

NDT Salary Overview 2026: Key Facts

  • PAUT/TOFD specialists earn 40–80% more than MT/PT baseline technicians
  • Offshore NDT work commands a 30–50% premium over onshore
  • API certifications (API 510, API 570, API 653) add $15,000–$30,000 in annual salary
  • NDT salary growth (4–7% annually) outpaces inflation
  • Independent consulting rates run $150–$300/hour depending on specialization
  • Houston pays roughly 40% more than small manufacturing towns

NDT Salary by Certification Level (Level 1, 2, 3)

Certification level is the primary salary driver. Level I is an entry-level assistant, Level II performs and interprets inspections independently, and Level III develops procedures as the subject matter expert. NDT Salary by Industry

  • Oil & Gas Upstream/Offshore: highest — $100K–$180K Level II with offshore premiums and specialized methods
  • Refinery & Petrochemical: very high — $85K–$130K Level II; turnaround daily rates of $1,000–$1,500 for specialists
  • Power Generation (Nuclear): very high — $85K–$125K Level II with strong job security
  • Aerospace & Defense: high — $75K–$110K Level II, premium for advanced-method expertise
  • Consulting & Services: $80K–$160K Level II equivalent, highest ceiling for senior consultants
  • Manufacturing & QC: medium — $50K–$70K Level II

Offshore NDT Salary, Overtime & Per Diem

Base salary is only part of NDT compensation. Onshore oil & gas overtime adds 10–20% annually, per diem runs $75–$150/day when traveling, and shift premiums add 15–20%. Offshore packages stack a rotation allowance ($40,000–$60,000/year on 2:2 rotation), hazard pay, and isolation premiums for a total offshore premium of 30–50% over onshore — offshore PAUT technicians in the Gulf of Mexico or North Sea reach $200,000–$280,000 total compensation.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average NDT technician salary in 2026?

The median NDT Level II salary in the USA is $55,000–$80,000, varying sharply by method: MT/PT technicians earn $50,000–$65,000, while PAUT/TOFD specialists earn $80,000–$110,000. Overtime adds 10–20% onshore and 30–50% offshore.

What is the NDT Level 2 salary in the Gulf (UAE and Saudi Arabia)?

NDT Level II technicians in the UAE earn roughly AED 8,000–15,000/month ($27,000–$49,000/year) tax-free, rising to AED 15,000–22,000/month ($49,000–$72,000) with PAUT. Saudi packages run $35,000–$55,000 tax-free. Housing allowances, annual flights, and medical cover typically add 30–50% on top of base salary.

How much does an NDT Level 3 earn?

ASNT Level III staff positions in the USA pay $80,000–$130,000; senior or consulting Level IIIs earn $130,000–$180,000+. Independent Level III consultants billing $150–$250/hour realistically net $180,000–$300,000 at 60–70% utilization. Multi-method Level IIIs with API certifications command the top of the range.

What does a PAUT technician earn in 2026?

Level II PAUT technicians earn $80,000–$110,000 onshore in the USA, $100,000–$140,000 offshore, and $110,000–$130,000 in Houston when combined with API 510/570 certifications. Level III PAUT specialists reach $130,000–$180,000, and independent PAUT consultants bill $150–$300/hour.

How much do offshore NDT technicians make?

Offshore NDT pays a 30–50% premium over onshore. Typical Gulf of Mexico or North Sea packages: $500–$800/day on 12-hour shifts with 2:2 rotation, yielding $170,000–$268,000 total annual compensation for Level II with rotation allowances, hazard pay, and employer-covered travel.

Which countries pay NDT technicians the most?

Adjusted for tax and benefits: the USA (Houston, $75K–$105K Level II), Australia (AUD $90K–$130K), the UK North Sea (£50K–£75K plus contract day rates), and the tax-free Gulf states (UAE, Saudi Arabia) lead. India offers lower nominal pay but 5–10% annual growth and a 3–5x premium for returning international-experienced technicians.

How can I increase my NDT salary?

The proven levers, in order of impact: add PAUT/TOFD/AUT qualifications (+40–80%), earn API 510/570/653 certifications (+$15,000–$30,000/year), reach Level III (+30–60%), take offshore or turnaround assignments (+30–50%), and relocate to a high-demand hub.
